$comment: REQ-STARTUP-142: the release-time inputs of the notices generator (tools/notices/notices.mjs). lgplCorrespondingSourcesAddress is the single address, reachable without an account and monitored by the maintainers, by which a recipient requests the corresponding sources of the LGPL-licensed components; the generator writes it into the header of THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt as a literal string. It is owner item O-3 (docs/architecture/first-release-plan.md section 6) and is left empty until the owner gives it: while it is empty, or only a placeholder, notices validation fails and names this key (REQ-STARTUP-143). The value must have an address's shape: one e-mail address (a display name before it in angle brackets is fine), or a postal address of more than one part, separated by commas or line breaks (\n), with a number and words in it. Refused: a web page; more than one e-mail address; a no-reply route; a placeholder word (N/A, none, TBA, TODO, REPLACE_ME and the like) or a template field name (Name, Street, City, Country); a stock template address (Address line 1, 123 Main Street, Anytown, Musterstadt); a domain reserved for examples and tests (example.org), a top-level label no mail reaches (.tld, .domain, .local, .lan, .internal), or a template's domain or local part (domain.com, host.com, test@, foo@, user@). The check is a word-and-shape heuristic (first-release-plan.md section 4.3): it cannot tell that an address is the owner's, so write the real one.
